v.why: Adding the input-to-output residual helps far more when it replaces a missing edge (13, 20-22: often +20 to +37) than when it replaces an existing conv or pool (17-19).
Without the 0->3 skip, deleting edge 0 starves nodes 1 and 2 and collapses accuracy (31, 32), while with the skip present the effect is small (23-29).
If edge 1 is already absent, removing edge 0 disconnects the whole intermediate path (30, 31: down to -36 on CIFAR-10).
When edge 4 is missing, edge 5 is the only conv route into the output, so removing it is very damaging (64, 65) compared with the near-neutral cases.
A skip on 1->3 partly stands in for the missing residual when edge 3 is none (82, 88, 90), but it is redundant or harmful when edge 3 is already a skip (81, 83-86).
Swapping in a skip on 0->2 gives the cell a shortcut that is useful only when there is no direct residual (94 is positive on all three datasets; most others with e3=skip are negative).
With e0 = skip, making e4 a skip creates a parameter-free 0->1->3 path in parallel with the 0->3 skip, so conv capacity is lost (84: -23 on CIFAR-100; 89).
In pooling-dominated cells the network has little learnable capacity, so adding a residual brings only small gains (15) compared with conv cells.
If edge 5 is none, node 2 never reaches the output, so adding a conv on 0->2 brings no benefit and changes optimization (34, 36, 42 all show negative CIFAR-100 changes).
With edge 5 absent, the 0->1 edge feeds the only remaining conv path to the output (via edge 4), so removing it is catastrophic (32: -42 on CIFAR-10).

raw:
These hypotheses come from the 100 experiments above plus known structure of NAS-Bench-201. The main pattern is that the edge 0→3 skip connection matters most. Edits that remove it, add it, or substitute for it interact most strongly with whether it is already present. A second pattern is that edits which cut or reroute paths hurt much more when the cell has no other way to carry signal to the output.

Several hypotheses rest on only one or two direct comparisons. These are #7, #8 and #10, and #9's support (34 and 36 vs. 33 and 35) is clear only on CIFAR-100. Those four depend more on architectural reasoning than on the measured data.
